tagline: Active ownership and sustainable investment leadership
hero_kpi_rationale: Engagement central to the group's ESG program, aligned with the obligations of the Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance and reflecting the strategic decarbonization priorities of European insurance. Concrete measure of shareholder impact on the climate transition of the investment portfolio.
company_description: Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A. provides various insurance solutions under the Generali brand in the Americas, Italy, rest of Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. The company operates through Life, Property & Casuality, and Asset & Wealth Management segments. It offers savings, individual and family protection, and unit linked products, as well as motor third-party liability, home, property and casualty, accident, health, and commercial and industrial risks insurance products; and insurance plans for multinational companies. It also provides equity and fixed-income funds, and alternative products. The company was formerly known as Assicurazioni Generali Austro-Italiche and changed its name to Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A. in 1848. Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A. was founded in 1831 and is headquartered in Trieste, Italy.

kpis.name: Corporate dialogues
kpis.explanation: Number of private or public dialogues with invested companies.
kpis.description: Generali conducted 14 corporate dialogues in 2021 across portfolio decarbonization, exclusion policy, coal-dependent countries, and diversity initiatives.
kpis.signal: Active engagement activity across ESG material topics

kpis.name: Voted meetings
kpis.explanation: Number of shareholder meetings where votes were exercised.
kpis.description: Generali voted at 1,073 shareholder meetings in 2021, reflecting active shareholder governance across global portfolio.

kpis.name: Positive voting results
kpis.explanation: Number of votes on Materiality Matrix topics that contributed to passing shareholder resolutions or blocking management proposals.
kpis.description: Generali's votes on Materiality Matrix topics contributed to 25 positive outcomes in 2021, including passed shareholder resolutions or blocked management proposals on climate, governance, and social issues.
kpis.signal: Tangible voting outcomes advancing ESG priorities

kpis.name: Portfolio decarbonization engagements
kpis.explanation: Number of dialogues with carbon-intensive issuers to influence climate change strategy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
kpis.description: As member of Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance, Generali engaged 4 carbon-intensive issuers in 2021 (1 individually, 3 collectively as co-leader) toward Science-Based Targets in utilities, energy, steel, cement and transportation sectors.
kpis.signal: Direct portfolio impact on real economy decarbonization

kpis.name: Exclusion policy engagements
kpis.explanation: Number of dialogues related to exclusion policy (corruption, environment, governance).
kpis.description: Generali conducted 6 exclusion policy engagements in 2021: 2 on corruption, 3 on environment, 1 on governance. Results included 1 corruption case removed from watchlist, 1 environment case closed with improvements, 1 governance case resolved.
kpis.signal: Active ESG risk monitoring and remediation

kpis.name: Coal-dependent country engagements
kpis.explanation: Number of engagement activities in countries heavily dependent on coal for energy transition.
kpis.description: 4 engagements conducted in coal-dependent countries in Central Eastern Europe in 2021, with 1 termination of business relationship achieved.
kpis.signal: Geographic focus on energy transition in emerging markets

kpis.name: Institutional activities
kpis.explanation: Number of activities conducted with networks and affiliations to influence policymakers and standard setters.
kpis.description: Generali conducted 7 institutional activities in 2021 through networks and affiliations on climate change, women and minorities inclusion, and transparency in business purpose.
kpis.signal: Systemic influence via industry networks and standard-setting

kpis.name: Positive engagement results
kpis.explanation: Number of dialogues that led to tangible results (watchlist removals, closed cases, business relationship terminations).
kpis.description: 4 dialogues achieved tangible results in 2021: 1 corruption watchlist removal, 1 environment case closure with improvements, 1 governance case closure, 1 business relationship termination.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital returned to shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in billions EUR. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Exposure to controversial sectors
risks.summary: Generali commits to avoiding insurance coverage for controversial sectors such as thermal coal, tobacco, or weapons, to prevent reputational damage linked to environmental or ethical controversies.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the active ownership report, with strong language on 'reputational risks'. The trend is stable, and the category is central to the group's ESG strategy.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.summary: Digital transformation increases reliance on IT systems, exposing Generali to cyberattacks, security breaches, and loss of sensitive customer data.
risks.score_rationale: The report highlights challenges related to IT system security in the context of the 4th industrial revolution. The language is concerned, the trend is upward, and the topic is strategic.

risks.title: Climate-related regulatory pressure
risks.summary: Generali faces increasing regulations related to climate change, requiring it to gradually exit coal and fossil fuel-related activities in its insurance portfolio.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the report, with strong language on decarbonization commitment. The trend is upward, and climate regulation is a strategic priority.

risks.title: Dependence on partners' governance
risks.summary: Generali depends on the governance quality of its clients and partners, especially in high-risk sectors, which may indirectly impact its own performance and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in the voted resolutions, with emphasis on governance of insured companies. The language is moderate, trend is stable.

risks.title: Risks related to emerging technologies
risks.summary: The adoption of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence or facial recognition poses ethical, legal, and operational risks for Generali, particularly regarding human rights compliance.
risks.score_rationale: The report explicitly mentions risks from new technologies such as facial recognition. Language is concerned, trend is upward.

risks.title: Increased competition in sustainable insurance
risks.summary: The rise of insurers specialized in sustainability and social responsibility intensifies competition, forcing Generali to innovate and strengthen its differentiation.
risks.score_rationale: Although not directly stated, Generali's ESG positioning exposes it to growing competition in the responsible insurance market. Trend is upward.

risks.title: Risks related to online disinformation
risks.summary: As an investor and insurer, Generali is exposed to reputational consequences from the spread of false information online, particularly through digital platforms it may insure or finance.
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions support for resolutions on disinformation. Language is concerned but indirect. Trend is upward.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI-related initiatives in the Active Ownership Report 2021. Focus is on shareholder engagement, corporate dialogue, proxy voting, and ESG governance.
evidence: No reference to AI or emerging technologies
